Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station pays tribute to Polibiomes Station, and this station is named after the fact that this station is located to the east of Polibiomes Station.
  • The direction "East" is usually represented by Yellow and Orange, as in the case with Flask East Checkpoint and Intus Orient Gateway. However, as Yellow is already used in Polibiomes Station, orange is used in this station.[2]
  • The Southern Part of this station share structure with Southern Ridge Tunnel.
  • The Public Transport Interchange below this station is also built by Nazca Railway.[3]

History[]

  • June 15 2022: This Station completed construction.[4]
  • June 16 2022: This Station began services.

Description []

Eastcoast Line is a proposed east-west oriented line of Peckern Transit in Los Sengas, and would have run between Peckern North and Peckern.

This line is represented by orange on the Route Map, and is Line Number 3.

History[]

  • May 1 2017: Kasukano Train Railway shuts down, and this line is taken over by Los Sengas Government.
  • May 6 2017: Peckern Transit is established and takes over this line.
  • June 4 2018: This line became a part of the Co-Op Railway.
  • October 25 2022: Peckern South-East Coast Line is approved and replaced this line.

Districts Served (Proposed)[]

  • Peckern North
  • Peckern

Rolling Stock[]

Platforms[]

Length[]

All Stations along the line would have adopted the standard platform length of 78m.

Platform Screen Doors/Gates[]

All Eastcoast Line Stations would have been equipped with Platform Screen Doors and Platform Gates.

Future Development[]

Since the takeover by Peckern Transit, Peckern Main Line, which had a similar area of service operated by Nawis Railway and had a more direct route, had rendered the plans of this route obsolete, and this line has never been built.

However, subsequent feasibility studies have seen that development along the line was not mature enough at the time when this line was first raised. After repeated rerouting, this line became Peckern South-East Coast Line.

Description []

Echo Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through Jupiter and Oasis Bay.

This line is represented by Light Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number E.

History[]

  • S3E4: Europa - Tat Stone Hill
  • S3E12: Europa - Snipe Valley

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Extend Westwards from Europa Checkpoint to the South of Twenty-Second Continent and subsequently Teraleros along Oasis Bay Line. TBC

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Down Extend Westwards from Europa Checkpoint to Summer Point Gateway and subsequently Teraleros through Joyhill Island, where it interchanges with Kinight Line and Oasis Bay Line. TBC

Districts Served[]

  • Jupiter
  • Oasis Bay

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • Oasis Bay Line (West): Europa - Tat Stone Hill

Fun Facts[]

  • This line was established with giving the Original Echo Line a second life in mind. Hence, the color scheme and terracotta used for this line is the same as that of the Old Echo Line.
  • For a year and a half since the establishment of this line, it only ran between Europa and Tat Stone Hill. Hence, it was jokingly referred to by players as the "Checkpoint Linker". However, this nickname disappeared after its extension to Snipe Valley Station.
  • During Pre-Season 4 Phase 3, this line was renamed from its original name of Epsilon Line to its current name.
  • This line will extend to Akashi Line Summer Point Gateway and Daybreaker Line, Starshore Line, Kilo Line Spring Point Gateway in the future.

Echo Line was a Veloduct of NR Los Sengas Division. With 2 stations along the line, this line was established on March 29 2016, and ran between Kong Corner and Prosand. However, on March 25 2017, exactly one year after this line began existing in name, this line merged with Bravo Line, and Echo Line was abolished.

Description []

Echo Line was one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It served as the Express Line of Stadium Line to the east of Splended River, and ran across Yowah. This line was also the first Veloduct to be established.

This line was represented by Light Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number E. At the time of its existence, this line was 3.24 km long and had 2 stations.

It is now merged with Bravo Line.

History[]

  • S2E2: Kong Corner - Prosand
  • S2E11 (Merger with Bravo Line): Edward Island - Prosand
  • While this line began existing in name on March 25 2016, it was established on March 29 2016 alongside Prosand Station.

Line Characteristics[]

  • This line was the first line to be established in Season 2.
  • This line was the first Veloduct to be established. (Not Alpha Line)
  • This line was the first Veloduct to NOT pass through Metropolis Terminal.
  • This line was the shortest Veloduct in Nazca Railway.
  • This line used to be the express line for Stadium Line. However, the express line became Bravo Line after the merger, and extended to the east in the name of Bravo Line along Stadium Line tracks before extending to the Twenty-Second Continent to the west.
  • The section between Raytree and Prosand of this line shared tracks with Stadium Line.
  • This line is the first line to be merged in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • The name of this line was resurrected during Pre-Season 4 Phase 3 when Epsilon Line is renamed Echo Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • While there is another Nawis Railway station with the same name (Southern Corridor Eclipse Fields Station), there are no connections between these two stations.
  • This Station only has one exit. It adopts a crowd control pattern in a fashion similar to Grand Junction Station and connects to Craneplaz Racecourse.
  • This Station features a passenger flow control to and from the Exit. A set of stairs and elevators are provided for entering and leaving the station respectively.
  • The Name of this station alludes to the British Race Horse of the Same Name.[2] The Chinese Name of this station also refers to the offsprings of the horse and Eclipses, hence the name of this station.
  • The color scheme of this station alludes to the nearby Craneplaz Racecourse.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Eclipse refers to a phenomenal event in which the moon temporarily obscures the sun as, while the Moon is 400 times closer to the Earth than the Sun, the Sun is also 400 times larger than the Moon. The Yellow and Black Wools represent the Sun and the Eclipse respectively.[2]
  • The Low Platform Depth of this station is contributed to the fact that the Island Owner at the time of the construction of this station wants to build a station that shares structure with this station and is located above the body of this station.[3] While the station on this island has yet to be built, reserved structure leading to the station is seen at the Exit B Passageway.
  • This Station is the first station at which the Station Control Room has two exits.[4]

    • Eclipse Island Yat King Estate Station (Interchange with Yat King Line)
    • Eclipse Island Observatory Station
    • Eclipse Island Passle South Station (Interchange with Passle Line)

Edward Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago. It is located at the south of the West Metropolis Archipelago, near Twenty-Second Continent. This island is named after three administrators of Project Nazca who have made a lot of contributions to the server, and are coincidentally all named Edward.

However, on February 29 2020, due to historical reasons, the former owner of this island permanently left the server, and a year afterwards, new plans to turn this island into an island with Olympic-grade facilities are put in place. As a result, this island is currently being re-developed.

Fun Facts[]

  • The color scheme of this station pays tribute to Edward Hill Station in Terracept Division.
  • This station, as well as the island on which station station is located at, is named to commemorate three players who were formerly in Project Nazca, and who were all named Edward. In Los Sengas Division, there are four other stations that are built to commemorate different people in Project Nazca who are named Edward and had contributed to this server, namely Comp Ward, Pan-ward, Comic Ward and Ani Ward, and these stations are built to commemorate the respective Edwards.
  • Despite having only three exits in total, this station is the most structurally complex station in West Metropolis Archipelago. It was also the most structurally complex station in Los Sengas Division until the completion of Europa Checkpoint.
  • Despite being built as an Area Station, this station already had all the station facilities upon construction just as in the case with Rover Down Checkpoint.[2]
  • This station is the permanent terminus of the following lines:
    • Kinight Line Down Direction.[3]
    • Interisland Line Down Direction.
  • This station was originally named Edward Island Station. However, on March 28 2017, this station became a four-line interchange to assist the arrival of Interisland Line, which was established one week later on April 4 that year. Therefore, this station became the third Checkpoint in Los Sengas Division, and is the first instance of an Area Station becoming a Checkpoint in Nazca Railway.
  • The Platform layout of Kinight Line and Interisland Line alludes to the old East Rail Line platforms in Hung Hom Station before East Rail Line crosses Victoria Harbour. It should also be noted that, before the establishment of Interisland Line, Kinight Line uses Platforms 3 to 6 of this station. This is equivalent to East Rail Line using the old Platforms 1 to 4 of Hung Hom Station between 1975 and 2004.[4]
  • The South End of Platforms 3 and 6 of this station are curved.

History[]

  • November 2 2015: This station began services alongside New Edward Line, but Platforms 3 to 8 have yet to begin services.
  • November 3 2015: Kinight Line extends from Ani Ward Station to this station, and Platforms 3 to 6 began services.
  • September 9 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works, and the Alpha Line reserved platforms have been redistributed to Bravo Line.[5] At the same day, Bravo Line is established, and extends from Metropolis Terminal to this station. Platforms 7, 8 begaun services.
  • March 28 2017: This station became a Checkpoint.
  • April 4 2017: Interisland Line is established, and uses Platforms 4, 5 of this station. Starting from that day, Kinight Line only used Platforms 3 and 6.
  • July 2 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • August 5 2020: The Kinight Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[7]
  • April 23 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Edward Line was the sixth line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between Axis Island and Loop Bank, and had a total of 21 stations. It was established alongside Silva Temple Station on June 25 2013. However, on March 10 2015, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description[]

Edward Line was the sixth District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled from the south of Terracept Continent to Tropic Continent through Vertin Peninsula in a south-north orientation.

This line was represented by the Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 5.

At the time of its closure, this route was 28.91 km long, with a total of 21 stations.

History[]

  • June 25 2013: Axis Island - Fare Well Cliff
  • July 5 2013: Axis Island - Edward Hill
  • November 6 2013: Axis Island - Bend Coast
  • July 3 2014: Axis Island - Loop Bank (Line Complete)

Egress Line is Line Number 19 of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line has 9 stations, and while it first appeared on July 19 2017, it wasn't established until five days later. It runs between Banyan and Rapid Rivulet.

Description []

Egress Line is one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Internal Sea and Egress.

This route is represented by Dark Orange on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 19.

Currently, this route is 13.35 km long, with a total of 9 stations.

History[]

  • S2E14: River Rendezvous - Rapid Rivulet
  • S3E9: Banyan - Rapid Rivulet

Districts Served[]

  • Internal Sea
    • Three Line Island
  • Egress
    • Egress Continent

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • One of the permanent termini lays in Internal Sea. (Banyan)
  • The section between Parallel Bay and Rapid Rivulet serves as an "express service" for East Ring Line that skips Quarter Basin Station. This calls for a more direct journey between these two stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line was originally named Outgress Line, but after much discussion, it is renamed Egress Line.
  • This line was originally Line Number 18.

Egret Docks Station is a station on Flask Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Odyssey. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 3521, Line 3522, Line 3523 (Egret Docks Stop).

title: Element Hub Transit
safeHtml:
Element Hub Transit, abbreviated as EHT, is one of the operators involved in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme. It took part in development in Period 5, as well as the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway.

Operations[]

Railway[]

  • Hook Sand Line: A line built in Period 5 of the Co-Op Railway. It extended in the Continous Development Phase, and runs between Charm River or Spinstone End and Out Sand. It also provides direct services with Southern Corridor of Nawis Railway.
  • Evillow Line: A line built in the Continuous Development Phase of the Co-Op Railway. It runs between Bottom Woods and Closouth Heights.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Station Wrap of this station is located at a high location to suit the theme of this station "Elevate" and "looking up".[2] Moreover, a Skylight is also set up at the top of this station to suit the same theme.[3]
  • The Skylight at Xylog Gate Station takes reference from this station.
  • While Arcgo Line originally had plans to serve this station, due to routing conflicts with the NFC, plans for this station to serve Arcgo Line are scrapped.
  • While Exit A originally planned to have three branches (Exits A1, A2, A3), plans to set up Exit A3 are scrapped mid-construction.

title: Elytra
safeHtml:
The Elytra is a means of Transport in Los Sengas. Users can wear Elytras to fly in the sky at extremely high speeds. However, it is recommended that players equip at least 64 rockets, otherwise risks of players falling into the sea before reaching his/her intended destination may arise. It is also recommended for players to equip at least 2 Elytras that are enchanted with Unbreaking III, otherwise Elytras may become damaged, and players may also fall to their deaths if it took place over land.

Contents

  • 1 Flying Speeds
  • 2 Effects
  • 3 See Also
  • 4 Citations and References

Flying Speeds[]

When using Rockets as propulsion, the speeds of Elytra can reach up to 130 km/h. Elytras enchanted with Unbreaking III have a durability of 27 minutes and has a range of approximately 58.5 km.

  • Flight Times taken:
    • Metropolis to Info Island: 2 Minutes
    • Southeast Island to Info Island: 5 Minutes

Effects[]

  • The number of passengers using Nazca Railway and other means of land transport will reduce.
  • May cause the Server TPS to decrease.
  • Rockets that feature Firework Stars may cause bodily harm and even death to nearby players or the player him/herself.

See Also[]

  • Los Sengas Transport

Citations and References[]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is built beneath a mountain, and a passageway is provided to connect between Exits A and B of the station, which are situated at different height levels of the mountain and provides a more convenient means of access between the two sides.
  • Exits A and C of this station adopts the Exit Style of New Edward Line stations at the Twenty-Second Continent with regards that the stairs and elevator exits are integrated.
  • The shape of the concourse in this station takes the form of an Emerald Item in Minecraft.[2]

History[]

  • January 10 2023: This station completed construction.[3]
  • January 12 2023: This station began services.
  • March 15 2024: This station completed exit naming, and Exit C is added to this station.
  • November 9 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]
